Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E046.

  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Daniel Gutierrez (E046) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role. Requested write is within the full-time limit and at or below the requested level, so recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - role: Payroll Specialist (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read

Per policy, full-time employees may have up to write (admin only if their role owns the system). The requested level (write) is at or below the full-time maximum, so write is granted. The security note's contractor classification conflicts with HR's employment record; employment type is determined by HR, so I rely on the HR note.
